items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I had to learn how to play the drum from Mr. Walter Page.

ctx.x: How do you mean that, Jo?

It's very difficult to teach people how to play with people, not for people. Because to be able to sit up on the bandstand and play with the people that you play with and sit and listen - the drum is a very unique instrument since it is the first. You sit and listen to learn how to play with people before you play for people. It's an automatic thing if you're going to play for an audience, you got people out there.
